title: Garrett Nussmeier feels 100 percent after dealing with "stabbing pain" in abdomen in 2025

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Garrett Nussmeier feels 100 percent after dealing with "stabbing pain" in abdomen in 2025
sources.description: Just before the start of the 2025 season, former LSU quarterback Garrett Nussmeier was the co-betting favorite to be selected at No. 1 overall in the 2026 draft.
